title: Stability curve
statement: For a real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, its stability curve at $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$ is $\sum_{S\subseteq[n]}\rho^{|S|}\widehat f(S)^2$, where $\widehat f(S)$ is the Fourier coefficient indexed by $S$.
